name: Precious Micaela Alop
intro: I build web systems with PHP and MySQL, design the interfaces people actually use, and make the posters and publicity materials for my student council. I'm always eager to learn the next thing.
about: Hi, I'm Mica, a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student at La Consolacion College Tanauan.
I love both sides of building software: writing the code that makes a system work and designing how it looks and feels. My projects range from PHP and MySQL systems to UI designs and prototypes.
As PRO of our student council, I handle publicity materials and technical tasks. That keeps my design and editing skills sharp and teaches me to deliver for real deadlines and real audiences.
